extras: Warning: Keep all devices on the same version to prevent metadata loss during sync.
intentEvidence: Tempo is built on top of ObsidianSimpleTimeTracker by Ellpeck (MIT licensed)
problem: Users need a way to track time spent on specific tasks directly within their notes without relying on external applications.

relations.evidence: Tempo is built on top of ObsidianSimpleTimeTracker by Ellpeck (MIT licensed)
Tempo exposes a public API for use with plugins like Dataview.

summary: Tempo is a minimal time tracker that logs time directly within Obsidian notes using code blocks, persisting data via timestamps and providing statistical aggregation.
